{{Quote|Look out!|A woman gives away the Rodian's position to Kyle Katarn|<ref name="DF2" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Rodian bounty hunter''' was hired by the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] was one of many [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired by the [[Model 88-series administration droid|droid]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to hunt down and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] if he was able to escape death at the [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. Katarn did [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|escape]] 8t88's men in the cantina, and the Rodian attempted to lay a trap for the former agent in the underbelly of Nar Shaddaa. However, a [[Unidentified Rebel sympathizer (Nar Shaddaa)|Rebel sympathizer]] gave away the Rodian's whereabouts when Katarn arrived, and the bounty hunter was subsequently eliminated by Katarn.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Thank you.|A Rebel sympathizer thanks Katarn for killing the Rodian|<ref name="DF2" />}}
[[File:Rebelagent.jpg|thumb|left|150px|The Rodian encountered Kyle Katarn in the underbelly of Nar Shaddaa]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]<ref name="DF2M">The ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' game manual labels all [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] in the game as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]].</ref> was hired by the [[Model 88-series administration droid|Model 88-series administration]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88]]<ref name="DF2" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]<ref name="TNEC" /> on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], along with numerous other bounty hunters. 8t88 hired the gunmen in preparation for a [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (5 ABY)|meeting]] with the former [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]], who wanted to know the [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|identity]] of his [[Morgan Katarn|father's]] [[Death/Legends|murderer]]. However, in favor of the remaining forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], 8t88 planned to double-cross Katarn, as he could impede 8t88's and the Empire's goals. Along with a [[Unidentified Gran (Rimmer's Rest)|Gran bounty hunter]] and [[Unidentified bounty hunter (Rimmer's Rest)|another hired gun]], 8t88 met with Katarn in the [[Rimmer's Rest/Legends|Rimmer's Rest]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]. The role of the Rodian and the other bounty hunters was to act as backup, in case Katarn was to escape 8t88's cronies in the cantina. After 8t88 enacted his scheme, leaving Katarn to die in the cantina,<ref name="DF2" /> the resourceful former agent bested and disarmed the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and his partner<ref name="DFRA">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref> and dived into the [[City/Legends|city]]-moon's depths after 8t88, looking to reclaim a stolen [[Datacard/Legends|datadisc]]. Katarn caught up with the droid and recovered the disc while 8t88 escaped. Katarn's next goal was to rendezvous with his [[Moldy Crow/Legends|ship]] and its [[Jan Ors|pilot]], which meant going deeper into Nar Shaddaa's bounty hunter infested establishments.<ref name="DF2" />

Meanwhile, the Rodian waited in the underbelly, and laid a one-[[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] ambush.<ref name="DFG">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''</ref> He took his place right around a corner, two floors under a staffed control center. The Rodian was out-of-sight for those who would come through the area until they had turned the corner into the Rodian's small room. In addition, the Rodian was accompanied by a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Unidentified Rebel sympathizer (Nar Shaddaa)|female]]. The Rodian stood over by a wall, putting the woman between him and anyone who would enter the room, giving himself a Human shield.<ref name="DF2" /> However, the woman was a Rebel sympathizer.<ref name="DFG" /> Eventually, Katarn made his way to the Rodian's location. The bounty hunter made a comment as Katarn came near, and soon enough Katarn was just next to the room. The woman saw Katarn and frantically warned the former agent of the Rodian's presence while making a run for the other side of the room.<ref name="DF2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II}}
The Rodian attacked Katarn as the man jumped into the room.<ref name="DF2" /> Despite being a deadeye with his [[Unidentified blaster pistol model (Post-Imperial era)|blaster pistol]],<ref name="DFG" /> the Rodian's attacks failed to subdue the target. Katarn [[Lightfight|retaliated]] and fatally dispatched the [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned bounty hunter. The woman thanked Katarn for killing the Rodian, which had put her in harms way, and the former agent continued on his way. Right down the hall from the Rodian's enclave were two Gran bounty hunters, who attempted to do what their Rodian ally had failed to accomplish. However, they, like the rest of 8t88's hirelings, only met a swift end at the hands of Katarn as he escaped the Smugglers' Moon.<ref name="DF2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
The Rodian was a cold-[[Blood/Legends|blooded]] bounty hunter who was willing to put the lives of others at risk just to ensure that he would get his quarry. However, he did little to restrain those who could put a potential ambush at risk. His mistake to keep the woman from giving his position away was ultimately fatal. Despite this, the Rodian was very skilled with his [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], and could easily score direct hits on his targets. However, Katarn proved to be the better combatant during their brief standoff.<ref name="DF2" />

The Rodian had green colored skin with brown spots and black [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He was shorter than Katarn,<ref name="DF2" /> who stood at 1.8 [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="negc" />

==Equipment==
The Rodian bounty hunter was armed with a blaster pistol during his time on Nar Shaddaa. The blaster was little more than a black box with a barrel attached to it, but it was incredibly accurate. Its accuracy was put to good use by the Rodian, who was a good shot. During his encounter with Katarn, the Rodian wore a white [[Jumpsuit/Legends|jumpsuit]] and a brown [[Clothing/Legends|vest]].<ref name="DF2" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Rodian first appeared, unnamed, in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'', which was released in [[October]] [[1997]], as an enemy character during the game's second level. The Rodian was further detailed, although only briefly, in the game's [[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide|official strategy guide]]. Although players could also kill the woman who was next to the Rodian, the guide suggests that they spare the women, lest they fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side of the Force]].<ref name="DFG" /> As such, this article assumes that Katarn only killed the bounty hunters, and spared all civilians.

When players near the Rodian's stakeout, the Rodian can be heard muttering something. However, it is not translated. The voices for all Rodians were provided by [[Roger Jackson]].<ref name="DF2" />
